agent.problem: This is a who question, but the wrong answers are invented categories rather than real details from somewhere in the Bible. In particular, people waiting too long and people asking too many questions are not biblical details being reused as distractors.

rule.text: For who, which thing and where questions, wrong answers are real details from somewhere in the Bible, like Joppa when the right answer is Tarshish.

agent.problem: The question relies on "that man's" to point back to the preceding cards instead of identifying the man itself. It should identify him as the man who fears the LORD so the question remains self-contained.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
